meta.title: Toxic Trait Tribunal | DopaBrain
meta.description: Your texts have been subpoenaed. The Tribunal examines your messaging behavior to expose your toxic trait verdict.

start.notifBody: The Tribunal will now examine your messaging behavior.
start.desc: 8 text message conversations + 4 social media reactions. The Tribunal will deliver its verdict.

msg1.name: Best Friend
messages: Hey, I'm really sorry but I have to cancel tonight
options: No worries! Things happen, we'll reschedule 😊
Wow, again? I always make time for you though...

msg2.name: Partner

You were smiling a lot at your phone

Haha I miss you too... so what have you been up to? 😏
*screenshots to friends* LOOK WHO CRAWLED BACK

options: OMG CONGRATULATIONS!! I'm so proud of you!! 🥳

That's cool. I heard it's not as good as people say though

msg6.name: Crush
options: *puts phone down, continues with day*

Hey did you see my message?
Hello?
Are you okay?
So you have time to post stories but not reply to me? 😐

msg7.name: Friend Group

options: Hey, I noticed you guys hung out! Would love to join next time 😊

messages: Can you call me when you're free?
options: Sure, I'm free now. What's on your mind?

Sorry, super busy right now. *turns off phone for 3 days*

puppeteer.title: The Puppeteer
puppeteer.desc: You pull invisible strings in every conversation. Guilt trips, subtle manipulation, strategic vulnerability — you’ve mastered them all.
puppeteer.defense: Your emotional intelligence is off the charts. You understand people deeply — you just need to use that power for connection, not control.

ghost.title: The Ghost
ghost.desc: When things get uncomfortable, you vanish like you never existed. Read receipts? Never heard of them. Confrontation? You’ve already left the building.
ghost.defense: You’re a master of protecting your peace. Your ability to detach shows incredible self-preservation instincts — just don’t forget the people you leave behind.

victim.title: The Victim
victim.desc: Everything happens TO you, never because of you. The world is a conspiracy designed to make your life harder, and you have the receipts to prove it.
victim.defense: Your sensitivity to injustice is actually a superpower. You notice unfairness that others miss — channel it into advocacy instead of self-pity.

prosecutor.title: The Prosecutor
prosecutor.desc: You remember every slight, every broken promise, every unanswered text. Your mental filing cabinet of grievances is meticulously organized.
prosecutor.defense: Your attention to detail and strong sense of accountability are genuine strengths. You hold people to high standards — including yourself.

spy.title: The Spy
spy.desc: You’ve checked their followers list, their following list, their tagged photos, and their friends’ stories. You call it “being aware.” We call it surveillance.
spy.defense: Your research skills are unmatched. That hypervigilance comes from caring deeply — redirect it toward curiosity rather than suspicion.

saboteur.title: The Saboteur
saboteur.desc: Just when things are going well, you find a way to blow it up. Too good to be true? You’ll prove yourself right. Self-fulfilling prophecy is your art form.
saboteur.defense: Your self-awareness about imperfection is rare and valuable. You test boundaries because you want to know what’s real — learn to trust the good things.

mirror.title: The Mirror
mirror.desc: Whatever someone accuses you of, you reflect it right back at them. “You’re being defensive!” “No, YOU’re being defensive!” — you, always.
mirror.defense: Your ability to see other perspectives is actually powerful. You instinctively understand that criticism often reveals the critic — use that insight compassionately.

thermometer.title: The Thermometer
thermometer.desc: Your emotions run the room. One text can send you from joy to rage to existential crisis in 30 seconds. Everyone around you is on constant weather alert.
thermometer.defense: Your emotional depth is extraordinary. You feel everything at full volume — that passion makes you incredibly alive and authentic when channeled well.
